description: Université Gustave Eiffel publishes the MFD Calibration package, which supplies tools for calibrating macroscopic fundamental diagrams to analyse urban congestion. Its native description identifies preprocessing, scaling, longitudinal analysis, data fusion and automated calibration and validation. Zenodo archives a particular GitHub commit in one ZIP and provides the deposit freely under CC BY 4.0. The record represents the software package, not a new traffic measurement dataset. Coverage is generic urban traffic; a fixed deployment city, time horizon, sampling interval and full input schema are not stated. The related ACUMEN passenger-estimation models address different multimodal quantities. A limitation is that no calibration accuracy, installation requirements or numerical implementation was checked. The source archive was not opened and no traffic data were processed, so the stated validation functionality does not demonstrate validated performance in a particular network.
